annotations.title: Create an account for your user

description: Create a Mango Inventory account for your user, in their name. Works without an account. Use it only when your user asked for an account and gave you their name, their email address and the name of their organization; never guess any of them. Mango Inventory sends them ONE email; when they press its button, the address is confirmed and they are signed in. You get no password or key. After they confirmed, call any account tool (for example get_setup_status): your client shows its normal sign-in step (in Claude Code: run /mcp), your user approves, and you continue with every tool. Until they press the button nothing can be done in the account, and if they never do, nothing happens. Pass their language for the email and the app.

currency.description: Their currency, if you know it: chf (default), eur, gbp or usd.

email.description: Your user's email address, as they gave it.

language.description: Their language for the email and the app: en (default), de, fr, it or es.

name.description: Your user's name, as they gave it. Up to 100 characters.

orgName.description: The name of their organization (school, company, club, brigade, workshop), as they gave it. Up to 100 characters.

orgType.description: The kind of organization, if you know it (as in check_fit).

name: create_account
